name: Tangerang Runners
description: Friendly weekend crew running scenic loops around BSD City and Alam Sutera. Pacers cover beginner to sub-5:00/km groups.
schedule: Every Saturday 05:30 WIB at Taman Gajah

name: JakBar Pacer
description: West Jakarta's tempo-and-track community. Mix of road runners and trackies hammering Senayan oval reps midweek.
schedule: Every Wednesday 19:00 WIB at GBK Stadium

name: Bekasi Run Club
description: Suburban run club focused on long Sunday miles around Summarecon Bekasi. Strong supportive Strava chat group.
schedule: Every Sunday 05:00 WIB at Summarecon Mal Bekasi

name: Bandung Highlanders
description: Hill-loving runners in Bandung. Weekly route stitches Dago, Punclut, and Lembang for honest elevation gain.
schedule: Every Saturday 06:00 WIB at Lapangan Gasibu

name: Jakarta Pace Lab
description: Data-nerd running collective. Workouts published with target paces and HR zones for half and full marathon training blocks.
schedule: Every Tuesday 19:30 WIB at Senayan Sport Complex

name: Tangsel Trail Pack
description: Off-road focused. Trail-shoe Saturday runs across Sentul, Cilodong, and Bukit Pelangi when the rain calms down.
schedule: Every Saturday 05:30 WIB at BSD Green Office Park
